I see... You're still refusing to judge anything. Even this sunshine, or this department store.
你还是……不想做出判断吗。不管是对阳光，还是对这百货店。

Don't you understand? This is it. The end of the Grand Magasin. You can struggle to your heart's content, but that won't magically bore a hole in this reality to exit through. 这里就是百货店的终点了。无论如何挣扎，都是无法从这里出去的。

So why... why do you keep trying to make a "different choice"? Tell me. I want to know what your endgame is.
可为什么要反反复复地……尝试其他选择呢？我很好奇啊。你的目的究竟是什么呢。

Though we could all hear what Jeanne was saying... we knew every word was meant for Meursault alone.
虽然我们所有人都能听到让娜的话……但那些话语都只在对默尔索一人诉说。

Meursault closed his eyes, as if considering something. When he opened them again, he cast a brief glance toward the Sinners and me.
默尔索似乎闭上眼沉思了片刻，随后睁眼瞥向我和罪人们所在的地方。

... It is to let them out of here.
……为了让他们从这里出去。

I'd been watching you for a long time before I decided to be a part of your life.
在进入你的日常之前，我观察了你很久。

Ma puce, stop kidding yourself. Do you really think I won't notice when you're just letting someone else make the judgment call?
小可爱。那不是你的判断，你以为我看不出来吗？

Suspirations that become wandering breezes; tree branches that dig deep enough to become soil; stones that become landscape; things that were once petals or blades of grass...
不管是飘荡的气息，深埋进地下的树根，不知何时放下的巨石，曾是花草的东西。

People twisting themselves for expression, for meaning... this City, doing much the same...
还是渴望去展现什么，渴望去寻找意义的人们，或是这座都市。

They're all... directionless, drifting movements, nothing more.
全都……不过是在漫无目的地漂流。

That day we first met, I thought you were someone who felt and experienced all of that minutiae of existing. That's why I decided to talk to you.
因为确信你是感受了那一切，经验了那一切的人……那天，我才向你搭了话。
